title: 합동참모본부 직제 / queue:ADDENDUM:28266:20170905:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Decree of the Military Personnel Management Act) <Presidential Decree No. 28266, September 5, 2017>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted>
Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.
Article 4 (Amendment of Other Statutes) (1) through (79) Omitted.
(80) Part of the Decree on the Organization of the Joint Chiefs of Staff shall be amended as follows:
In Article 4 (1), "ministerial-rank officer" shall be replaced with "general officer."
In Article 5 (1), Article 6 (1), Article 7-2 (1), Article 8 (1), Article 9 (1), Article 10 (1), Article 11 (1), and Article 12 (3), "ministerial-rank officer" shall each be replaced with "general officer."
(81) through (90) Omitted.
